_comment: Reference test vectors for the safekey algorithm (docs/SAFEKEY.md). Phase 0 ships 10 vectors as a placeholder; the full set of 100 is a Phase 0 deliverable per docs/PHASES.md and is generated in coordination with BiblioFetch.jl. Format: { input: <ref string>, expected: <safekey> }. Both Rust and Julia implementations MUST produce identical output for every entry.

vectors._section: Non-ASCII characters — algorithm step 1 replaces every char outside [A-Za-z0-9._-] with '_'. Since the result is pure ASCII before the byte-slice in the truncation branch, multibyte input cannot panic at `&trimmed[..192]`. Distinct ASCII prefixes are used here to keep collision-resistance valid; refs that differ only in their non-ASCII suffix WILL collide on safekey output, which is a known consequence of the algorithm and a Phase-1 caller responsibility (cf. docs/SAFEKEY.md §6 property tests).
